mapper.sql: p.price_id, p.tenant_id, p.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, p.customer_id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, p.trade_type, p.unit_price, p.currency, p.tax_type, p.vat_included_at, p.foreign_unit_price, p.order_type, oci.item_nm AS order_type_name, (ds.customer_id IS NOT NULL) AS default_supplier, m.unit AS material_unit, m.material_spec, CASE WHEN p.end_dt IS NOT NULL AND p.end_dt < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'past' WHEN p.start_dt > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'future' ELSE 'current' END AS price_status, p.start_dt, p.end_dt, p.moq, p.use_at, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at

LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ocg ON ocg.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND ocg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item oci ON oci.group_id = ocg.common_code_group_id AND oci.item_code = p.order_type LEFT JOIN tb_item_default_supplier ds ON ds.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND ds.material_id = p.material_id AND ds.customer_id = p.customer_id AND p.trade_type = '매입'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tb_item_partner_price p LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = p.material_id AND m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.price_id = #{priceId}

SELECT material_id AS "materialId", material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName" FROM tb_material_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND delete_status = 'N' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT customer_id AS "customerId", customer_code AS "customerCode", customer_name AS "customerName" FROM tb_customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND use_at = 'Y'

SELECT m.material_id AS "materialId", m.material_code AS "materialCode", m.material_name AS "materialName", m.material_spec AS "materialSpec", m.unit AS "materialUnit", m.material_type_code AS "materialTypeCode", COALESCE(pc.customer_count, 0) AS "customerCount", ds.customer_id AS "defaultSupplierId", dc.customer_code AS "defaultSupplierCode", dc.customer_name AS "defaultSupplierName" FROM tb_material_info m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.material_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM tb_item_partner_price p JOIN tb_customer_info pcu ON pcu.customer_id = p.customer_id AND pcu.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND pcu.use_at = 'Y' WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.trade_type = #{tradeType} AND p.use_at = 'Y' GROUP BY p.material_id ) pc ON pc.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN tb_item_default_supplier ds ON ds.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND ds.material_id = m.material_id AND #{tradeType} = '매입' LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info dc ON dc.customer_id = ds.customer_id AND dc.tenant_id = ds.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.delete_status = 'N' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_spec ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND m.material_type_code IN
#{itemType}
AND COALESCE(pc.customer_count, 0) = 0
AND COALESCE(pc.customer_count, 0) >= 2 AND ds.customer_id IS NULL
ORDER BY m.material_code LIMIT 2001

SELECT c.customer_id AS "customerId", c.customer_code AS "customerCode", c.customer_name AS "customerName", c.business_no AS "businessNo", COALESCE(cnt.price_count, 0) AS "priceCount" FROM tb_customer_info c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS price_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT cp.customer_id, cp.material_id, cp.trade_type FROM tb_item_partner_price cp JOIN tb_material_info cm ON cm.material_id = cp.material_id AND cm.tenant_id = cp.tenant_id WHERE cp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cp.trade_type = #{tradeType} AND cp.use_at = 'Y' AND (cp.end_dt IS NULL OR cp.end_dt >= CAST(#{effectiveOn} AS DATE))
AND cm.material_type_code IN
#{itemType}
) d GROUP BY d.customer_id ) cnt ON cnt.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.use_at = 'Y'
AND (c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.business_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND COALESCE(cnt.price_count, 0) > 0
AND COALESCE(cnt.price_count, 0) = 0
ORDER BY c.customer_code LIMIT 2001
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_item_partner_price SET end_dt = CAST(#{endDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS DATE), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND price_id = #{predecessorId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_item_partner_price WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND price_id = #{priceId}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_item_partner_price ( tenant_id, material_id, customer_id, trade_type, unit_price, currency, tax_type, vat_included_at, foreign_unit_price, order_type, start_dt, end_dt, moq, use_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{materialId}, #{customerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{tradeType}, #{unitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{currency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taxType}, #{vatIncludedAt}, #{foreignUnitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orderType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{startDt} AS DATE), CAST(#{endDt} AS DATE), #{moq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{useAt}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING price_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_item_partner_price SET material_id = #{materialId}, customer_id = #{customerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, trade_type = #{tradeType}, unit_price = #{unitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, currency = #{currency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, tax_type = #{taxType}, vat_included_at = #{vatIncludedAt}, foreign_unit_price = #{foreignUnitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, order_type = #{orderType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, start_dt = CAST(#{startDt} AS DATE), end_dt = CAST(#{endDt} AS DATE), moq = #{moq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND price_id = #{priceId}
mapper.select:
SELECT d.material_id AS "materialId", d.customer_id AS "customerId", c.customer_code AS "customerCode", c.customer_name AS "customerName" FROM tb_item_default_supplier d JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.material_id IN
#{materialId}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_item_partner_price p JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND c.use_at = 'Y' WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.material_id = #{materialId} AND p.customer_id = #{customerId} AND p.trade_type = '매입' AND p.use_at = 'Y' )
mapper.update: INSERT INTO tb_item_default_supplier (tenant_id, material_id, customer_id, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{materialId}, #{customerId}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, material_id) DO UPDATE SET customer_id = EXCLUDED.customer_id, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tb_item_default_supplier.customer_id <> EXCLUDED.customer_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_item_default_supplier WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' AND g.use_at = 'Y' AND i.use_at = 'Y' AND (i.item_code = #{text} OR i.item_nm = #{text}) ORDER BY (i.item_code = #{text}) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.unit_price AS "unitPrice", p.tax_type AS "taxType", p.vat_included_at AS "vatIncludedAt", p.foreign_unit_price AS "foreignUnitPrice", p.currency AS "foreignCurrency", p.order_type AS "orderType", oci.item_nm AS "orderTypeName" FROM tb_item_partner_price p LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ocg ON ocg.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND ocg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item oci ON oci.group_id = ocg.common_code_group_id AND oci.item_code = p.order_type WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.material_id = #{materialId} AND p.customer_id = #{customerId} AND p.trade_type = #{tradeType} AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND p.start_dt <= CAST(#{baseDt} AS DATE) AND (p.end_dt IS NULL OR p.end_dt >= CAST(#{baseDt} AS DATE)) ORDER BY p.start_dt DESC, p.price_id DESC LIMIT 1
